name: The Bird's Nest
note: Design map (M13.0). The roofless tower at the back of the inn that Erin sketches as the Bird's Nest (4.12) and the Antinium finish in 4.29; Bird keeps watch, shoots birds and sleeps there (4.18, 4.29, 4.30). Out in the open, so winter cold applies. The size, the wooden rail and the ladder are guesses.
